answer_1.quote: In this work, we explored the ability of large PLMs to perform zero-shot analogical reasoning in visual Raven's Progressive Matrices (RPM).
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are selections of the correct matrix completion from a set of choices, generated via language model prompting based on abstracted task representations.

answer_2.quote: Models are evaluated on a random subset of 500 testing examples from each sub-task of RAVEN.

answer_4.quote: In , human performance on RAVEN was measured by giving subjects some task-specific training, then evaluating them on the original visual form of the task.
answer_4.guideline: Human subjects were evaluated on the original visual form of the RAVEN task after receiving task-specific training.
